mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM biz_payment WHERE intent_id = #{intentId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND deleted = false AND status = 'succeeded')
SELECT ,order_id,fulfilled_deal_id FROM biz_payment WHERE id=#{id} AND intent_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT deleted
SELECT user_id,status,amount,currency,fulfilment_result,order_id,fulfilled_deal_id,intent_id FROM biz_payment WHERE id=#{id} AND intent_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT deleted
SELECT FROM biz_payment WHERE id=#{id} AND intent_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT deleted FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM biz_payment WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND request_key=#{key} AND NOT deleted

SELECT FROM biz_payment WHERE intent_id=#{intentId} AND NOT deleted AND (status IN ('created','succeeded') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM biz_payment_review_case r WHERE r.payment_id=biz_payment.id AND r.status='open')) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_payment (,payment_no,provider) VALUES (#{id},#{intentId},#{userId},#{operation},#{businessId},#{amount},#{currency},#{quoteValidUntil}, #{businessDeadline},#{requestKey},#{createTime},#{sessionExpiresAt},#{successUrl},#{cancelUrl}, #{checkoutSessionId},#{checkoutUrl},#{providerPaymentIntentId},#{status},#{version},CAST(#{id} AS text),'stripe')
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_payment SET checkout_session_id=#{checkoutSessionId},checkout_url=#{checkoutUrl}, provider_payment_intent_id=#{providerPaymentIntentId},status=#{status},version=version+1, paid_time=CASE WHEN #{status}='succeeded' THEN COALESCE(paid_time,clock_timestamp()) ELSE paid_time END, update_time=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND NOT deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO log_payment_webhook_event(event_id,event_type) VALUES(#{eventId},#{type}) ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO biz_payment_review_case(payment_id,reason) VALUES(#{id},#{reason}) ON CONFLICT(payment_id) DO UPDATE SET reason=EXCLUDED.reason,status='open', next_check_at=clock_timestamp(),resolved_at=NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_payment_review_case SET owner=#{operator},next_check_at=#{nextCheck} WHERE payment_id=#{id} AND status='open'

UPDATE biz_payment_review_case SET owner=#{operator},last_checked_at=clock_timestamp(), next_check_at=clock_timestamp()+interval '15 minutes',provider_summary=#{summary}, status=CASE WHEN #{resolved} THEN 'resolved' ELSE 'open' END, resolved_at=CASE WHEN #{resolved} THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE NULL END WHERE payment_id=#{id}
UPDATE biz_payment SET fulfilment_result=#{outcome},fulfilled_deal_id=#{dealId},order_id=#{orderId} WHERE id=#{id} AND fulfilment_result IS NULL AND NOT deleted
mapper.select: SELECT fulfilment_result FROM biz_payment WHERE id=#{id} AND NOT deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_refund(payment_id,intent_id,deal_id,amount,currency,reason,source_event,status) SELECT id,intent_id,COALESCE(fulfilled_deal_id,CASE WHEN operation='JOIN' THEN business_id END), amount,currency,#{reason},#{eventId},'pending' FROM biz_payment WHERE id=#{id} AND NOT deleted AND status='succeeded' ON CONFLICT(payment_id) DO UPDATE SET payment_id=EXCLUDED.payment_id WHERE NOT biz_refund.deleted AND biz_refund.amount=EXCLUDED.amount AND biz_refund.currency=EXCLUDED.currency AND biz_refund.reason=EXCLUDED.reason
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM biz_payment WHERE fulfilled_deal_id=#{dealId} AND NOT deleted AND fulfilment_result='FULFILLED' AND status='succeeded' ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_refund(payment_id,intent_id,deal_id,amount,currency,reason,source_event,status) SELECT id,intent_id,fulfilled_deal_id,amount,currency,#{reason},#{eventId},'pending' FROM biz_payment WHERE fulfilled_deal_id=#{dealId} AND NOT deleted AND fulfilment_result='FULFILLED' AND status='succeeded' ORDER BY id ON CONFLICT(payment_id) DO UPDATE SET payment_id=EXCLUDED.payment_id WHERE NOT biz_refund.deleted AND biz_refund.intent_id=EXCLUDED.intent_id AND biz_refund.deal_id=EXCLUDED.deal_id AND biz_refund.amount=EXCLUDED.amount AND biz_refund.currency=EXCLUDED.currency AND biz_refund.reason=EXCLUDED.reason
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM biz_refund r JOIN biz_payment p ON p.id=r.payment_id WHERE p.id=#{id} AND NOT p.deleted AND p.status='succeeded' AND r.amount=p.amount AND r.currency=p.currency AND r.intent_id=p.intent_id AND NOT r.deleted AND r.status IN ('pending','processing','succeeded','failed','review'))

SELECT FROM biz_payment WHERE intent_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT deleted AND ((status='created' AND create_time < #{threshold}) OR (status='succeeded' AND fulfilment_result IS NULL) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM biz_payment_review_case r WHERE r.payment_id=biz_payment.id AND r.status='open')) ORDER BY create_time,id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id,last_create_time,last_payment_id FROM sys_checkout_expiry_cursor WHERE job_name='checkout.expiry' AND NOT deleted FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_checkout_expiry_cursor SET last_create_time=#{afterTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, last_payment_id=#{afterId,jdbcType=OTHER},update_time=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id} AND NOT deleted
